name: MPM Memory
description: Memory slot backed by MPM (Memory Persistence Module). Routes memory_search/memory_get through `mpm call mpm_memory --payload '{"action":"query",...}'` (the 2026-08-11 aggregator tool). FTS5-only recall (no semantic vector). Replaces the default memory-core. Requires MPM installed on PATH and the agent configured with `plugins.slots.memory = "openclaw-mpm-memory"` to clear the `core/doctor/memory-search` 'No active memory plugin' warning.

enabled.description: Master toggle. When false, the plugin is a complete no-op.

mpmBin.description: Path to the mpm binary. Default 'mpm' (PATH-resolved). NOTE: the OpenClaw gateway runs as a systemd --user service with a stripped PATH, so a PATH-resolved value like 'mpm' typically fails at runtime with 'spawn mpm ENOENT'. Always set this to an absolute path (e.g. /home/<user>/.local/bin/mpm or /home/<user>/.mpm/bin/mpm) — install.sh does this automatically on this host.

scope.description: MPM query scope. Default 'all' (federated local + shared MPM DBs).

limitDefault.description: Default memory_search limit when maxResults is omitted. Default 6.
